messages:
Olivia: Quick sync — final pass on Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing copy before Wed deploy. Need: hero line, 3 bullets, primary CTA, secondary CTA, and inbound lead routing rules. Also slotted webinar promo (Apr 8). Who wants to propose text?
Aaron: I can draft product-accurate hero lines. Quick principle: no hard SLA promises on Hosted (use targets), Dedicated = predictable capacity, Private = compliance & control.
Maya: For conversion: test CTA A = "Start free trial" vs CTA B = "Get a dedicated quote" on Dedicated page. Webinar RSVP should capture use-case (SaaS, Enterprise, Regulated).
Ella: Layout note — keep Hosted hero compact, Dedicated needs capacity diagram, Private gets security badges + short checklist. CTA styles: primary = bright, secondary = outline.
Aaron: Draft hero candidates: Hosted: "Hosted API: production-grade inference, zero infra setup". Dedicated: "Dedicated capacity: predictable throughput, reserved GPUs". Private: "Private deployment: VPC & on‑prem options for regulated workloads". Bullets to follow.
Olivia: Nice. Can we make Hosted line snappier? Maybe "Hosted API: fast, low-latency inference — start in minutes"
Tom: FYI — avoid exact latency numbers. We can use "low-latency" or "sub-100ms typical on short prompts (subject to model)" only in docs, not hero.
Aaron: Agreed. Bullets (Hosted): 1) Simple REST + SDKs; 2) Streaming & tool-calling; 3) Usage analytics + quotas.
Aaron: Bullets (Dedicated): 1) Reserved GPU pools; 2) Autoscale & burst options; 3) SLA-backed uptime & isolation.
Aaron: Bullets (Private): 1) VPC & on‑prem control plane; 2) KMS/HSM integrs & audit logs; 3) Customer-managed networking.
Julia: For inbound routing: Private page leads -> AE Enterprise queue (tag: private-deploy). Dedicated page leads -> sales-ops for capacity deals (tag: dedicated-inbound). Hosted leads -> self-serve MQLs by default, route to AE if ARR signal or manual demo request.
Maya: Plus add hidden field for "webinar_interested" on all forms when they click RSVP. Use utm_source=webinar for tracking.
Ella: Copy for webinar promo card: "Join our Apr 8 webinar: Serving LLMs at scale — tradeoffs, routing, and cost controls. RSVP to save a seat." Small CTA: "Reserve spot".
Olivia: Voting check — publish hero + bullets above? Maya: A/B test CTAs as suggested? Ella: designs ready after copy locked. Julia: confirm routing rules and tags to ops. Tom: thumbs up on copy edits, just hold numbers.
Maya: Also propose a short benchmark blurb on Hosted page: "Benchmarked on common chat workloads — see details in docs" (link). That keeps claim but links to evidence.
Olivia: Good compromise. Final call: we want to ship Wed 10am PT. Ops-bot, can you create the deploy ticket and add routing tags?
ops-bot: Created ticket #DL-4827 -> https://redwood.internal/tickets/DL-4827. Routing tags: private-deploy, dedicated-inbound, hosted-mql.
Olivia: Thanks all — I'll collate into the PR and ping design for assets. If anyone has alternate wording, drop short edits here. :sparkles:
